title: Algerian Quinoa Tagine
description: A flavorful and nutritious North African-inspired dish made with quinoa, aromatic spices, and tender vegetables.

ingredients.name: aromatic oil
ingredients.notes: such as olive or avocado oil

instructions: Heat the aromatic oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and sauté for 5 minutes or until softened.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chopped carrots and zucchini and cook for 5 minutes or until tender.
Stir in the algerian spice blend, salt, and pepper.
Add the diced tomatoes and water to the saucepan.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 15 minutes.
Fluff the cooked quinoa with a fork and stir it into the saucepan.
Cook for an additional 5 minutes or until the quinoa is heated through.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro if desired.
